description: A native macOS and Windows proxy client for mihomo (Clash.Meta). Built in Go with MyGo, no webview.
notes: Hop stores its data (subscriptions, settings, the bundled core) in %AppData%\hop, outside the Scoop install directory, so it is not persisted by Scoop and survives updates and uninstalls.
Launch Hop from the Start Menu shortcut, or from a shell with the shimmed command 'Hop'. Default local ports: 17890 (HTTP/SOCKS mixed proxy), 19090 (core controller).
Hop can update itself from GitHub releases; run 'scoop hold hop' if you want Scoop to remain the only updater.
Enhanced mode (TUN) installs a privileged helper service the first time you enable it, which requires administrator approval.
